name: Honeycomb
author: Erin Carter
description: A beveled hexagonal grid catching light — chamfered cells with lit and shadowed edges, a glow travelling cell to cell through the comb while the rest sit in cool shadow. Confident hard-edged geometry with a premium machined feel.

params.label: Cell count
params.effect: How many hex cells span the frame; low is bold and architectural, high a fine mesh.

params.label: Bevel
params.effect: Width and depth of the chamfered edges; low is flat tiles, high is deeply machined.

params.label: Flow
params.effect: Speed of the glow travelling across the comb; 0 holds the lit cells steady.

params.label: Lit fraction
params.effect: How many cells are lit at once; low is a sparse spark, high lights most of the comb.

params.label: Mouse influence
params.effect: How strongly the pointer lights nearby cells; 0 ignores the mouse.
